children: Guardian agreed lock-up covering ~29.9 million Class A shares held by founders, execs and employees through Sept. 14, 2027.
Lock-up agreements signed Sept. 10, 2026 with founders, executive officers and certain employees.
About 29.9 million Class A shares will be restricted, representing ~81% of founders/executives/employee-held Class A stock after conversion.
Lock-up covers period through Sept. 14, 2027, barring limited exceptions and without Company consent for transfers.
After automatic conversion of 13,521,396 Class B shares on Sept. 27, 2026, Guardian will have 63,320,300 Class A shares outstanding.
